query:
SELECT a.id, a.patientId, p.name as paciente, a.therapistUserId, a.startTime, a.endTime, a.status 
FROM appointments a
JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
WHERE a.patientId IN (1, 2) AND a.therapistUserId = 4
ORDER BY a.startTime DESC;
